snippet.title: 『Veritas Tales: Witch of the Dark Castle』Introduction Movie【INDIE Live Expo 2026.4.25】
snippet.description:

▼Click here for the Official YouTube
@digitalis_publishing 

Veritas Tales: Witch of the Dark Castle. The title and trailer revealed to the world for the first time is scheduled for release on Steam in 2026. It will support Japanese, English, and Simplified Chinese.
This RPG is a reinterpretation of classic gamebooks. Its feature is a deeply physical-style system where you write directly into an on-screen sheet with a pencil, and use dice to decide battles and events.
It's a game that lets you relive the old experience of adventuring with pen and paper, now set in the dark story of in a Dark Castle.
